reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis is scientifically sound: active-learning ML potentials are known to capture complex many-body configurations better than EAM, and applying this to CoCrFeNiMn near melting to improve TI phase-space overlap is a logical, well-supported extension of existing methods.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is clear and decisive, specifying a quantitative falsification criterion (≥50% error reduction) and measurable metrics (TI error, phase-space overlap), though practical details on AIMD simulation size and duration are omitted.
reasons.usefulness: This hypothesis directly addresses the core methodological gap in the research question, offering a concrete, testable intervention with a clear benchmark that would significantly advance the field if validated.
